clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following year: your mother's anxiety rose as she lay awake over money in March 1988, she and your father stopped talking about money by May 1988, your brother's grades fell by November 1989, and your mother's anxiety eased once she returned to work by March 1990. The shifts in money worry and distance between your parents sit in the months before the death; your brother's functioning fell after it; your mother's anxiety settled as she moved back into her work life.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother Della being told she had breast cancer in February 1995, within the surrounding years: you developed migraines that kept you in bed by March 1994, you called your brother most nights by April 1994, you stopped returning his calls by June 1995, and you stopped calling home by February 1996. Your move to college in September 1993 sits at the edge of this time. Your symptoms rose and your closeness to your brother shifted toward him and then away, as your mother's diagnosis arrived and settled into your family's life.
